title: F2 Material: unrelated unreadable task discards a known introducing diagnostic
detail: On d7502656, the same valid task move prints its unmarked violation alone, but combining its push with unreadable z.md returns only cannot-judge. Repairing z.md still cannot read its parent; the following unrelated edit is green and never reports the known defect.
released_user_and_normal_workflow: An adopter pushes multiple state-task commits and diagnoses/repairs one unreadable task; the runner explicitly supports cannot-judge recovery for unreadable blobs.
observable_harm: The unrelated, fully readable task's already collected move diagnostic is discarded, so its sole introducing-push report is lost permanently.
protected_boundary: value-ac[AC-3]: a defect is reported once at the commit that adds it; contract[docs/adr/0017-history-laws-judge-only-the-events-a-push-adds.md#decision]: each push event is judged at its commit.
falsifier: Removing the unrelated unreadable commit restores the expected diagnostic in the same valid task.
fix: Return through FO disposition; preserve known violations while accumulating cannot-judge errors per task/commit. No repair authorized or applied.

title: F3 Material: a tilde-fenced example suppresses a real unmarked replacement
detail: A real unmarked move plus a ~~~md example with the amendment marker exits 0 with no L4 event. The identical example in backticks exits 1 and names the unmarked move. The existing gate helper also inherits this fence handling; this candidate introduces its use in L4.
released_user_and_normal_workflow: An adopter worker moves criteria and includes a standard Markdown tilde-fenced example under Acceptance criteria; the amendment parser already recognizes tilde fences.
observable_harm: Example text is treated as a live replacement and the invalid move passes its introducing push without a diagnostic.
protected_boundary: value-ac[AC-2]: a move with no marked replacement yields a violation; contract[kc-dev-flow-2/references/sd/laws.md#l4-amendment-moves-use-fresh-ids]: a live criterion or another entry's moved declaration must carry the marker.
falsifier: Changing only the fence delimiter to backticks exposes the real unmarked move.
fix: Return through FO disposition; exclude fenced examples consistently while preserving the accepted design-check compatibility boundary. No repair authorized or applied.
